result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there are a few visual/functional inconsistencies: the bottom navigation highlights the wrong tab, a restaurant name is truncated, and a partially rendered filter chip appears at the right edge.

issues.description: The bottom navigation shows 'Profile' as the active (green) tab, but the screen displayed is clearly the Home feed (delivery address, search, restaurant lists). The active-tab state does not match the current screen.
issues.suggestion: Highlight the 'Home' tab when the home feed is displayed, ensuring the navigation active state stays in sync with the current view.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' shows a truncated restaurant name ('Trattoria Piccol...') that is clipped by the screen edge without an ellipsis or clear affordance.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis within the card bounds, or constrain the label width to the card so text isn't hard-clipped at the viewport edge.

issues.description: A category filter chip after 'Healthy' is cut off at the right edge with only a sliver visible, which looks broken rather than like an intentional scroll hint.
issues.suggestion: Show a larger visible portion of the next chip (e.g., 30–40% peeking) or add a fade/gradient at the edge to clearly indicate horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The 'DELIVER TO' label and delivery fee text use light gray on white, which may have insufficient contrast for readability.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1) for small text.
